currentTitleDe: Stoffe isolieren, reinigen und Ausbeute beurteilen
currentTitleEn: Isolate, purify, and evaluate yields of substances
currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann auf Grundlage physikalischer und chemischer Stoffeigenschaften geeignete Isolierungs- und Reinigungsverfahren auswaehlen, sicher durchfuehren, Reinheit und Ausbeute pruefen sowie die Taetigkeit dokumentieren.
currentDescriptionEn: The learner can select and safely carry out isolation and purification methods based on physical and chemical substance properties, check purity and yield, and document the work.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Isolierung und Reinigung nutzen unterschiedliche physikalische oder chemische Eigenschaften. Eine gewonnene Fraktion, ihre Reinheit und die bezogen auf den Ausgangsstoff oder die Theorie ermittelte Ausbeute sind verschiedene Aussagen; Verluste, Restlösemittel und mitgetrennte Stoffe begrenzen den Befund.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Isolation and purification use differences in physical or chemical properties. A recovered fraction, its purity and its yield relative to the starting material or theory are different claims; loss, residual solvent and co-separated substances limit the result.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Die lernende Person begründet für ein ausgewähltes beaufsichtigtes Gemisch den Isolierungs- und Reinigungsschritt, führt ihn nach konkreter Gefährdungsprüfung selbst sicher aus und dokumentiert eigene Stoffmengen, Handgriffe, Fraktionen und Verluste. Sie wählt eine zur Probe passende Reinheitsprüfung, deutet den begrenzten Befund und beurteilt die eigene Ausbeute mit eindeutiger Bezugsgröße.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: For a selected supervised mixture, the learner justifies isolation and purification steps, personally performs them safely after the specific risk assessment and records original amounts, actions, fractions and losses. The learner selects a sample-appropriate purity check, interprets its limited result and evaluates the original yield against an explicit reference.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Bei einem neuen Gemisch mit einem zusätzlich mitlöslichen Bestandteil oder geänderter Flüchtigkeit prüft die lernende Person selbstständig, ob der bisherige Trennweg und Reinheitsnachweis noch unterscheiden. Sie passt nach Sicherheitsfreigabe die tatsächliche Trennung oder Prüfung an, dokumentiert neue Beobachtungen und erklärt eine veränderte Ausbeute, ohne vollständige Reinheit aus Masse oder einem Einzelmerkmal zu erfinden.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: For a new mixture with an added co-soluble component or changed volatility, the learner independently checks whether the previous separation and purity test still discriminate. After safety approval, the learner adapts the actual separation or test, records new observations and explains the changed yield without inventing complete purity from mass or one feature.

rationale:
The official BcP12/13 LB2 asks learners to select isolation methods from physical/chemical substance properties, perform them safely, check purity and yield and document the activity. The unchanged DE/EN descriptions preserve this complete practical outcome. It is not satisfied by analysis-only or synthesis-only child performance.

The actual five direct foundations are guided safe investigation, hazard-label interpretation, chemical handling/disposal, risk reduction and transparent data documentation. They supply practical safety, record keeping and method-execution foundations without already mastering isolation, purity or yield. The current laboratory/preparation parent has no extra requires; removing broad sibling-dependent sequencing does not delete the five concrete foundations.

The text remains sufficiently specific for a selected supervised isolation/purification task and its changed-condition application. Reinheit pruefen requires a justified suitable check with limits, not an absolute purity guarantee; Ausbeute is a recovery/theoretical-reference judgement, not proof of purity. DE/EN preserve that distinction.

The personally inspected current Native whole page shows the exact description, current five prerequisite destinations and separate final-assessment reverse link without clipping. Its schematic workflow, melting-point sketch and yield formula are orienting; a sharp drawn peak or drawn mass ratio is not actual purity/yield evidence.

This targeted D revalidation does not approve a universal source/course obligation, the terminal-assessment prerequisite set, runtime selection or practical execution. BcP remains a separately selected Bavarian course, and other jurisdiction mappings need their own source evidence.

I personally viewed the exact new single-goal PDF-page export. Its complete unchanged description, full goal ID, figure and laboratory/preparation path are readable. The same five canonical prerequisites now appear as external destinations, with no prerequisite omitted or invented; the terminal reverse link is separate. This page organisation does not change my own earlier source-bounded isolation/purification judgement or the distinction between actual performance and the schematic purity/yield picture. The unchanged whole DE/EN description therefore still carries KEEP for this precise one-goal page context. The terminal link does not obtain course-allocation clearance from this amendment.
